name: oma.yr
author: nmlit (fork of Yr.no (unofficial) by Knut Åbjørsbråten)
description: yr.no (MET Norway) weather in the bar: current conditions, warnings, hourly graph and a 10-day table with precipitation. Fork of io.github.knutsi.yr.

barWidget.description: Current conditions, warnings, hourly graph and a yr.no-style 10-day table (night/morning/afternoon/evening, max/min, precipitation, wind) from MET Norway

schema.label: Refresh (minutes)
schema.description: MET Norway asks clients to poll at most every 10 minutes

schema.label: Units
schema.description: metric (°C, m/s, mm), imperial (°F, mph, in) or kelvin

schema.label: Graph hours
schema.description: Hours shown in the hour-by-hour graph
